message: Line 1 has '*' as the first non-blank character in column 8 (Area A) instead of the column 7 indicator; skipped as a comment.

01-level WS-SAVEPOINT-ID starts in Area B (column 12) inside EXEC SQL BEGIN/END DECLARE SECTION (lines 17-19); registered as a top-level WORKING-STORAGE record as found. The DECLARE SECTION delimiters are not data items.

COPY SQLCA (21), COPY DBPROC (22) and COPY ERRHAND (23) sit directly under WORKING-STORAGE (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0054-SEC-0002) with no enclosing 01; EXPANDS_COPY is held by the section. Their bytes count only in the copybooks' own records, not in this file's total_bytes.
